module "ParamSortOrder.dsf"

product 0 MaterialFunction "Functions/MF_LiParamSort" backend=Graph
  legacy root ""
  %0 = FunctionInput(InputName="First", InputType="Vector3", IsOptional=false, SortPriority=0) : float3 @L2:C1 "First"
  %1 = FunctionInput(InputName="Second", InputType="Vector3", IsOptional=false, SortPriority=1) : float3 @L2:C1 "Second"
  %2 = Add(%0, %1) : float3 @L14:C20 "OutColor"
  %3 = FunctionOutput(%2, OutputName="OutColor", SortPriority=0) @L2:C1 "OutColor"
  inputs %0, %1
  outputs %3
